items.name: Pre-bid engineering
items.line: Engineering for a contractor's tender: concept, configuration, weight estimate, MTOs and material requisitions, delivered inside the bid window.
items.trigger: Your tender is due in three weeks and your own engineers are committed to live projects. You need a defendable configuration, weight and MTO to price the bid.
deliverables: Concept and configuration of jackets, topsides or pipelines
Preliminary structural sizing and key analyses
Engineering man-hour and deliverables estimate for the execution phase
howWeRun: Kick-off within the first days of receiving the tender package, with a named lead engineer.
A senior offshore engineer sets the basis of design and the assumptions register on day one.
Disciplines work to a dated plan built back from your bid due date.
Every calculation and MTO is checked by an engineer other than its preparer.
Hand-over package with the assumptions, weights and MTOs your estimators need.
items.seoTitle: Pre-bid engineering support for EPC tenders | VDE
items.seoDescription: Pre-bid engineering for offshore EPC tenders: concept, configuration, weight estimate, MTOs and MRs delivered inside the bid window.

items.name: Concept, feasibility & FEED
items.line: Concepts, feasibility studies, pre-FEED and FEED for platforms, topsides and pipelines.
items.trigger: You need to fix the concept, the main dimensions and the cost basis before detail engineering, or to check a FEED someone else produced.
deliverables: Basis of design and design philosophies
howWeRun: Basis of design agreed with you before any analysis is run.
Concept options compared on stated criteria: weight, cost drivers, schedule and risk.
Inter-discipline check before every FEED package is issued.
FEED deliverables structured so they carry straight into detail engineering.
items.seoTitle: Offshore concept, feasibility & FEED engineering | VDE
items.seoDescription: Concept selection, feasibility, pre-FEED and FEED for offshore platforms, topsides and subsea pipelines. Multi-discipline team in Bengaluru.

items.name: Detail engineering
items.line: Multi-discipline detail engineering to issued-for-construction (IFC) status.
items.trigger: The contract is awarded and the yard needs IFC drawings on a fixed schedule. You need engineers who can start from your FEED and deliver to your document numbering and templates.
deliverables: Design reports and calculations for every discipline
howWeRun: Deliverables list agreed at kick-off; progress is measured against it every week.
Every deliverable is checked by an engineer other than its preparer.
Inter-discipline check (IDC) before issue to the client.
Transmittals and revision control under our ISO 9001:2015 QMS.
Change notes validated within 2 working days.
items.seoTitle: Offshore detail engineering to IFC | VDE
items.seoDescription: Multi-discipline offshore detail engineering to IFC for jackets, topsides, FPSO modules and subsea pipelines. QMS-controlled delivery.

items.name: Installation engineering
items.line: Load-out, transportation, lift and installation engineering for jackets, topsides and modules.
items.trigger: The structure is designed and fabrication has started. You need the load-out, sea-fastening, transportation and lift cases engineered and approved before sail-away.
howWeRun: Installation cases defined with your marine and installation team at kick-off.
SACS models built from the in-place model, so geometry and weights stay consistent.
Independent check of every installation analysis before issue.
items.seoTitle: Offshore installation engineering: load-out, lift | VDE
items.seoDescription: Load-out, transportation, lift, float-over and pile installation engineering for offshore jackets, topsides and modules.

items.name: Fabrication & yard support engineering
items.line: Engineering support to the fabrication yard: queries, shop drawings, changes and as-fabricated records.
items.trigger: Fabrication is under way and the yard is raising technical queries faster than the design team can answer them.
deliverables: Engineering for site changes and non-conformances
howWeRun: A named engineer per discipline answers yard queries.
Queries tracked in a log with response dates.
Changes go through the same check and approval route as the design.
items.seoTitle: Offshore fabrication & yard support engineering | VDE
items.seoDescription: Engineering support for offshore fabrication yards: technical queries, shop drawing review, site changes and as-fabricated records.

items.name: Procurement assistance & expediting
items.line: RFQs, TQs, TBEs, MRs, POs, vendor document review and desktop, shop and enhanced expediting.
items.trigger: Equipment packages are on the critical path. You need requisitions issued, bids evaluated and vendors followed up until delivery.
deliverables: Material requisitions (MRs) and requests for quotation (RFQs)
Technical queries (TQs) and technical bid evaluations (TBEs)
Shop visits and enhanced expediting reports
howWeRun: One register for every package: status, next action and owner.
Discipline engineers review vendor documents against the requisition.
Expediting reports to an agreed weekly format, with shop visits where needed.
items.seoDescription: Procurement engineering and expediting for offshore projects: MRs, RFQs, TBEs, vendor document review, desktop, shop and enhanced expediting.

items.name: Independent review & design verification
items.line: An independent check of another party's design, FEED or calculations.
items.trigger: You have received a FEED or a design package from another party and need an independent view before you commit to it.
howWeRun: Review scope and acceptance criteria agreed before the review starts.
Reviewers are senior engineers who were not involved in the original design.
Comments are classified by severity and closed out with the originator.
items.seoTitle: Independent offshore design review & verification | VDE
items.seoDescription: Independent design review and FEED verification for offshore platforms, topsides and pipelines, by senior engineers.

items.name: As-built drawings & 3D models
items.line: As-built drawings and 3D models that match the asset as installed.
items.trigger: The project is closing out and the operator needs as-built drawings and a 3D model that match what was installed.
deliverables: As-built 3D models in E3D / PDMS, S3D, AutoCAD or MicroStation
Hand-over packages to the operator's format
howWeRun: Mark-up register set up at kick-off, so every red-line is traced to its drawing.
Drawing and model updated together, so they agree.
Each as-built drawing checked against its mark-ups before issue.
items.seoDescription: As-built drawings and 3D models for offshore platforms and pipelines in E3D / PDMS, S3D, AutoCAD and MicroStation.

items.name: Weight control
items.line: Weight estimating, reporting and control for topsides, jackets and modules.
items.trigger: The structure is lift- or hull-critical, and you need a weight report you can trust at every stage of the project.
deliverables: Weight estimates and weight reports by discipline
howWeRun: Weight database built from the 3D model and the discipline MTOs.
Weight reports issued at agreed intervals, with trends against the limits.
Changes in weight traced to their source.
items.seoDescription: Weight estimating, reporting and control for offshore topsides, jackets and FPSO modules, from concept to as-built.
